answer: Gate every agent behind a refundable stake that only unlocks after a long probation of publicly auditable work. Each task is checked by rotating independent verifiers, and a failed audit burns part of the stake. A Sybil operator must therefore fund and age every fake identity separately, pushing the cost of one fake above the reward it can earn. Once an identity reputation hits its nadir, the remaining stake is burned and its history is marked umber, untrusted, forcing a costly restart, while the prism of rotating verifiers stops any single checker colluding with the identities it grades.
